cd /tmp/writable_ws && python3 -c "
import re
# Test different scenarios
tests = [
    ('(.+?) *', 'hello       '),
    ('(.+?) * world', 'hello       world'),
]
for pat, txt in tests:
    m = re.match(pat, txt)
    result = repr(m.group(1)) if m else None
    print(f'{repr(pat)} on {repr(txt)}: group={result}')
"
